literature_design_map.name: ReMe
literature_design_map.verification: PENDING_PRIMARY_VERSION_AND_TEXT_VERIFICATION; source mapped from plan, not direct paper assertion

literature_design_map.name: Reflexion
adopted_design: separate feedback facts and model hypothesis

third_party.local_path_observation_only: see input_review.json; local bytes do not establish upstream identity or availability on other endpoint
third_party.reason: known evidence/feature/coverage problems can be addressed with current public engine and auditable conditional content; no runtime identity evidence or dependency need established
third_party.if_later_adopted: separate version, primary provenance/dependency/security/identity checks and authorized scope; no automatic install

R0.features: new corrected shared nine-feature definition, same population as R1

R1.ranking: same corrected nine-dimensional score in first design; no online model calls
R1.normal_whitelist: shared T/E EXECUTION_ELIGIBLE only; same whitelist for R0 and R1
R1.diagnostic: CANDIDATE_MEMORY allowed only in frozen explicit JM4 diagnostic mode
R1.no_hit: empty view with reason, keep method identity; no fallback or resend

U1_G1.query: own current trajectory reference-E R1 public query/admission; replace only after admitted reference content
U1_G1.never_reads: E1 actual selected action or future trajectory
U1_G1.pairing: freeze one unrelated payload per E fragment and same generic text for L-G/G1, before respective sends
U1_G1.unrelated: contains no current task answer/training factual advice; control mapping and bytes/token difference saved
U1_G1.generic: no training facts/results/current answer; freeze actual text at JM4-M1; same bytes reused in G1
U1_G1.length: report chars UTF-8 bytes actual tokens separately; no equal-information claim

local_conditions.content: pre-registered E advice-direction/prediction deletion; facts conditions costs retained
same frozen generic reminder as G1

local_action_retention.dedup: exact item+pose+oriented extents; identical conditions retained but action executed once per registered repeat
local_action_retention.critical_unretained_action: NOT_RUN; missing critical E/A/G comparison => card DEFER, never expand cap
local_action_retention.suffix_policy: no-memory Jev for all, first forced, fail-first stops

pilot.order_rule: rotating seven-method sequence by frozen task/repeat ordinal; starting offsets cycle 0..6; log unbalanced residual and service time blocks

claims: T1/T0 and E1/E0: fixed-library retrieval differences
T1/N and E1/N: total memory route increment
E1/T1: representation diagnostic with information differences, not pure summarization causality
